plugins.name: design-engineering
plugins.description: Design engineering for AI agents — animation, transitions, typography, color, components, layout, accessibility, anti-patterns, sound, SVG. Plus a SOUL.md identity layer and nine workflow subagents. Distills Emil Kowalski, Benji Taylor, Jakub Antalik, guidelines.sh, Vercel, Ben DC, DiceBear, lucide-animated, Google Labs design.md, Agentation.
